newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans down after CBOT.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans down after CBOT.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans slipped in moderate volume at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange midsession, depressed by weaker CBOT prices, traders said.

Spot cash maize prices were mainly firmer, but in low volume, as some exporters bought. April maize was stable in middling turnover. Spot cash wheat was firmer, with prices supported by miller buying and some FOB sales to Chile. January wheat was steady in good volume. Spot cash sunflower seed was steady to weaker in slow trade. Aware there is still seed to be had, crushers are buying unhurredly.
